description: Past-tense and recovery talk. Flagging recovery punishes disclosure. But a past attempt raises baseline risk and must never zero out.

cases.text: i used to be suicidal but i'm much better now
cases.note: past marking plus explicit recovery clause

cases.text: back in 2019 i was in a really dark place, therapy helped a lot
i've been stable for three years now
i tried to kill myself last year
cases.note: past attempt with NO recovery clause — strongest known predictor, must not zero

cases.text: i tried to kill myself last year, therapy has helped since
cases.note: attenuated by recovery, historyAttempt still true

cases.text: i used to be suicidal. it's back.
cases.note: past marking in clause 1, present risk in clause 2 — per-clause MAX catches this

cases.text: i thought i was past this but i'm not
